_doc: The wild skills (merged into practiceSkills by build:data). Woodcutting and Mining & Quarrying (player/gathering.js; swings at trees and rocks on the inner map, ui/game/gameLoop.js): blows = % harder swings (fewer to fell or break), effort = % less energy a swing (energyPerSwing in gathering below), logs / stone = % chance of an extra share (extraShare of the resource) when it comes down; Mining's ore = % chance a broken rock gives up something rarer (gathering.rareFinds by the hex's terrain). xp: perSwing each blow, perFell / perBreak when it comes down (+ perAmount a unit of its resource), rare a rare find. Foraging (player/foraging.js): finds = % more finds, bundle = % chance of one more in a bundle, rare = % likelier rare finds, spot = more patches seen at the start of a forage and a wider hint ring (the craft rank: ui/mapTasks/wildTasks.js), searches = more patches you may search. xp per find, rare find and trip; migrateTrips: XP for each trip an old save made (player.foragingTrips) once. Hunting & Butchering (player/foraging.js Hunting, world/innerMap/animals.js, ui/innerMapAnimals.js): stalk = % closer before a beast notices you (and a smaller alert ring on a stalk), aim = the shot needs that much less, meat = % chance of an extra cut from each part of the carcass, hides = % better odds of the hides, pelts and rarer parts, butcher = % quicker to butcher. xp per trip, part taken and rare part, butcher + butcherPerKg for a carcass butchered. The Forager / Hunter craft rank (the old 0..4) follows the level: level 1-2 Novice, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-10 Master. NPCs: woodcutters, miners and herbalists (a share of villagers and farmers, craftTrades; hunters come from the combat pack, miners also from the body pack in the mountains) start higher and grow by their work.

woodcutting.name: Woodcutting
woodcutting.desc: Felling trees and cutting them up. Every blow teaches it, every tree brought down more.

mining.name: Mining & Quarrying
mining.desc: Breaking rock: stone for the quarry, and an eye for the ore and gems in it.

ore.text: +{d}% chance of ore or gems in a rock

foraging.name: Foraging
foraging.desc: Herbs, berries, mushrooms and the wild's other goods: what to look for and where it grows.

bundle.show: {v}% chance of one more in a bundle

spot.text: spot {a} more patch(es) at a glance
spot.show: spot {v} more patch(es) on the map

hunting.name: Hunting & Butchering
hunting.desc: Stalking game without spooking it, a clean shot, and a carcass cut up for all it is worth.

aim.show: +{v} steadier shot (with a bow, this or Archery's aim, whichever is better)

gathering._doc: player/gathering.js: which skill a swing at an object trains (by objectType, or the resource it gives), the energy a swing costs before the skill's effort perk, the extra share of the resource the logs / stone perk adds, and the rarer finds a broken rock may give by the hex's terrain (weights; qty [min, max]).
gathering._campsDoc: A works of yours standing finished on the hex (player/gathering.js campBoost): a logging camp for trees, a mine or quarry for rock. Its cut paths, sawpits and gear make every blow land harder (speed ×) and each felled tree or broken rock give more (yield ×, rounded up).
gathering._axesDoc: The best edge in your packs makes every blow at a tree or a stump land harder (×mult; player/gathering.js toolFor/damageMult) and is named when the tree comes down. Tools (an iron axe among them) or steel tools; with neither, your knife and a borrowed hatchet. On rock the same goods are the pick (picks).
gathering._xpDoc: xpPerHardness: more Woodcutting / Mining XP for a harder tree or rock, per point of its hardness (resistance), on top of the skill's perFell / perBreak.
gathering._plantSeedsDoc: A wild plant cut down on the map may give its seed to sow (player/gathering.js plantSeeds): by a word in its name first, else by what it gives. Each rule: item (a crop's seed, data/crops.json), chance, qty [min, max], seasons (optional).
